title: Mentuhotep IV
summary: Last king of Egypt's Dynasty 11, whose vizier Amenemhat became Amenemhat I.
description: Last king of Egypt's Dynasty 11, whose vizier Amenemhat became Amenemhat I. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Dynasty 13: 1729–1577–1479 BC"
reign.note: Start of the reign: seven years (Turin Canon) before the 1738 BC start of Dynasty 12.
